description: List the sportsbooks this account can link, the same list as the app’s Settings > Sportsbooks picker: each book (bookId, name, abbr) with the two-letter states it can be linked in. state (two letters, e.g. NJ) filters to the books linkable there; without it the account’s own linking state is used when its linked books share one. Use a listed book and state with connect_sportsbook. Never contacts a sportsbook.
name: list_linkable_sportsbooks
title: List sportsbooks I can link
